## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior, with a synthetic before/after example when useful. Link the issue (for example, `Closes #123`) if applicable.

## Validation

List commands/results, loaded-extension or production/visual evidence as relevant. State unrun checks and limitations. Human validation remains separate.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Focused change on a topic branch; contribution and conduct policies followed.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; documentation and meaningful tests updated when needed.
- [ ] Scope limits and pending human checks stated accurately.
- [ ] No secrets or private browsing data in code, reports or artifacts.
- [ ] Dependency changes assessed per ADR 003, or no dependency changes.
- [ ] Permission, contract, lifecycle or export changes include design/security assessment and full verification evidence, or are not applicable.

Maintainers: merge only after required CI and review. Do not bypass protection or push directly to main.
